Question B-001-009-009.

Why the correct answer is right: A person without an amateur certificate may operate only under supervision and in the presence of a properly qualified person.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "When the person has been briefed over the telephone by a person holding appropriate qualifications": A phone briefing lacks the required in-person supervision.
- sourceIndex 2: "When the person is actively enrolled in an amateur radio course": Course enrolment does not equal qualified supervision at the station.
- sourceIndex 3: "When the person holds a valid licence in the land mobile or maritime services": A licence in another service does not provide amateur-station operating authority.
